alignments.note: βλέπετε rendered by the support-verb phrase take heed; head on the meaning-bearing complement (rule 17).
μή introducing the clause of caution → lest.
Indefinite adverb πως → by any means; head on means, the word carrying the adverb's own sense, the preposition and determiner being helpers. A head on any remains defensible.
The demonstrative αὕτη occupies the English determiner slot, so the article realizes nothing (rule 38).
ἐξουσία → liberty; the ASV's margin records Or, power.
ὑμῶν → of yours, the case preposition riding with the pronoun.
Anarthrous πρόσκομμα with a supplied indefinite determiner, which is an ordinary helper on the noun (rule 51).
Article takes the English determiner with its case preposition riding along (rule 21), headed on the.
Substantival ἀσθενέσιν → weak; the determiner belongs to the article standing before it (rules 21, 58).

review_notes: v010 is underdetermined with the projection on r00-base, which the English permits; no textual decision is taken here (rule 12).
The article before ἐξουσία is unrepresented because the demonstrative αὕτη already fills the determiner slot (rule 38).
